name: cropcorn
description: Cropcorn — paste a YouTube link, trim a clip, download it or save it to your channel as Private.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "PORT=3000 npm run start:dev -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
